id: 03_Fundamentals of Laboratory Safety Safety Resources Scenario
title: 安全问题找谁问
source_doc: course/CDC Laboratory Safety Series/03_Fundamentals of Laboratory Safety Safety Resources Scenario.md
author_source: project/CDC Laboratory Safety Series/03_Fundamentals of Laboratory Safety Safety Resources Scenario/src.py

points.K2: 担心暴露：这样做允许吗
points.K3: 有哪些安全资源可以求助
points.K4: 本课不能代替本实验室规程
points.S3: 找实验室安全员和负责人
points.S4: 找学院和学校安全管理部门

shots.scene: 欣欣站在实验室和办公区之间的走廊上，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in a corridor between a laboratory door and an office area, waving at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课：遇到安全问题，找谁问？

shots.scene: 小研抱着电脑走进办公区，准备开组会
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student carries a laptop into a bright open office area with desks and a meeting table.
shots.narration: 小研来到办公区，准备开组会。

shots.scene: 阿杰穿着实验服、戴着护目镜，坐在办公桌前吃零食
shots.prompt_en: The young male student, still wearing a lab coat and safety goggles, sits at an office desk eating a snack.
shots.narration: 她看见阿杰穿着实验服，坐在办公桌前。

shots.scene: 阿杰的实验服袖口有一小块污渍，旁边是会议桌
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of the lab coat sleeve with a small stain, resting on a shared meeting table next to papers. No people.
shots.narration: 实验服上的沾染，可能跟着进了办公区。

shots.section_title: 担心暴露：这样做允许吗
shots.scene: 小研皱眉思考，头顶浮现问号
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student frowns thoughtfully, a question mark icon floating above her head.
shots.narration: 这会不会造成暴露？办公区允许这样吗？
overlay: 担心暴露：这样做允许吗

shots.section_title: 担心暴露：这样做允许吗
shots.scene: 污渍小点从实验服扩散到桌面、门把手、杯子的箭头示意
shots.prompt_en: Arrows showing small dots spreading from a lab coat icon to a desk, a door handle and a coffee cup icon. No people.
shots.narration: 污染会沾到桌面、门把手和水杯上。

shots.section_title: 有哪些安全资源可以求助
shots.scene: 欣欣站到小研身边，伸出手掌数指头
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands next to the female graduate student and counts on its paw.
shots.narration: 拿不准时，有哪些资源可以求助？
overlay: 有哪些安全资源可以求助

shots.scene: 实验室门内有挂衣钩，挂着实验服，门外是办公区
shots.prompt_en: A coat hook just inside a laboratory door with a lab coat hanging on it; the office area is visible outside the door. No people.
shots.narration: 先说规矩：实验服不出实验区。

shots.scene: 办公室、会议室、食堂三个图标，各有实验服图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: Three icons each with a crossed-out lab coat inside: an office, a meeting room, and a canteen. No people.
shots.narration: 办公室、会议室、食堂都不能穿。

shots.scene: 小研在门口脱下手套，扔进废物桶，再挂好实验服
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student removes her gloves at the lab door, drops them in a waste bin and hangs her lab coat on the hook.
shots.narration: 离开前脱手套、脱实验服，再洗手。

shots.scene: 书架上空白的安全手册和规程文件夹
shots.prompt_en: A shelf with a blank laboratory safety manual and blank procedure binders. No people.
shots.narration: 资源一：本实验室的安全手册和规程。

shots.scene: 小研翻到手册中画着实验服和护目镜的一页
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student opens the manual to a page showing only icons of a lab coat, goggles and gloves.
shots.narration: 防护用品怎么穿、在哪脱，里面都有。

shots.scene: 空白SDS页面上高亮一个护目镜和手套图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank safety data sheet with a highlighted section showing goggles and gloves icons. No people.
shots.narration: 具体化学品的防护，查SDS的防护部分。

shots.section_title: 找实验室安全员和负责人
shots.scene: 小研胸前戴着空白的安全员袖标
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student wears a blank armband marking her as the lab safety officer.
shots.narration: 资源二：实验室安全员，就在身边。
overlay: 找实验室安全员和负责人

shots.section_title: 找实验室安全员和负责人
shots.scene: 老周坐在办公室，阿杰敲门进来请教
shots.prompt_en: The older man sits in his office; the young male student knocks and comes in to ask a question.
shots.narration: 实验室负责人，对本室安全负总责。

shots.section_title: 找学院和学校安全管理部门
shots.scene: 王老师在学院办公室，桌上摆着空白的检查表
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator sits in a school office with blank inspection checklists on the desk.
shots.narration: 资源三：学院实验室安全管理员。
overlay: 找学院和学校安全管理部门

shots.section_title: 找学院和学校安全管理部门
shots.scene: 学校实验室安全管理部门的楼宇图标，旁边是电话和邮件图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a university administration building with telephone and email icons beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 还有学校的实验室安全管理部门。

shots.section_title: 找学院和学校安全管理部门
shots.scene: 王老师在培训室讲解防护用品，学生们认真听
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator explains protective equipment to a group of students in a training room.
shots.narration: 安全培训和咨询，都可以找他们。

shots.scene: 小研微笑着走到阿杰桌边，轻声提醒
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student smiles and walks over to the young male student's desk to remind him quietly.
shots.narration: 看到问题，先友善地当面提醒。

shots.scene: 阿杰不好意思地挠头，起身回实验室
shots.prompt_en: The young male student scratches his head sheepishly and stands up to walk back to the laboratory.
shots.narration: 阿杰马上回去，把实验服脱在室内。

shots.scene: 阿杰用湿巾擦拭刚才坐过的桌面
shots.prompt_en: The young male student wipes the office desk he used with a disinfectant wipe.
shots.narration: 刚才碰过的桌面，也擦拭干净。

shots.scene: 小研在空白的反映单上填写，交给王老师
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student fills in a blank feedback form and hands it to the safety administrator.
shots.narration: 反复出现的问题，向安全管理员反映。

shots.scene: 王老师在组会上用空白挂图讲规定，大家点头
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator speaks at a group meeting with a blank flip chart; everyone nods.
shots.narration: 提醒的是问题，不是针对人。

shots.section_title: 本课不能代替本实验室规程
shots.scene: 一张空白课程卡片和一本更大的空白规程手册
shots.prompt_en: A small blank course card next to a larger blank procedure binder with a check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 这门课不能代替本实验室的规程。
overlay: 本课不能代替本实验室规程

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现挂起的实验服和打叉的办公桌图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside icons of a lab coat on a hook and a crossed-out office desk.
shots.narration: 实验服、手套不出实验区。

shots.scene: 手册、SDS、安全员、管理部门四个图标排成一排
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: a manual, a data sheet, a person with an armband, and an office building. No people.
shots.narration: 手册SDS，安全员，学院和学校。

shots.scene: 两人握手图标
shots.prompt_en: A handshake icon above a small speech bubble. No people.
shots.narration: 友善提醒，及时反映，大家都安全。

shots.scene: 欣欣和小研、阿杰在实验室门口挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot, the female graduate student and the young male student wave goodbye at the laboratory door.
shots.narration: 有疑问就问，安全没小事，下次见！
